commit.message:
fix(deps): pin av 18.1.0 alongside faster-whisper 1.2.1

faster-whisper 1.2.1 calls av.open(..., metadata_errors="ignore"), a kwarg
PyAV 19 removed, so the faster-whisper 1.2.1 + av 19 pair fails every local
transcription with a TypeError. faster-whisper only declares av>=11, so an
unlocked resolve of [stt-whisper] picks av 19.0.2 today; only uv.lock's
av 18.1.0 kept locked installs working, and any lock refresh would break
local STT on every voice message.

No faster-whisper release carries the upstream fix (SYSTRAN/faster-whisper#1495);
1.2.1 (2025-10-31) is still the latest on PyPI, so an upgrade is not
available. Exact-pin av==18.1.0 (released 2026-08-12, already the locked
version) in [voice] and [stt-whisper] with faster-whisper's platform marker,
per the exact-pin policy for direct deps. uv.lock only records the new
requirement; no resolved version changes.

A metadata regression test asserts every extra carrying faster-whisper 1.2.1
also exact-pins a pre-19 av under the same marker.

Fixes #135245
